narrative:

The most influential factor in this decision was your credit history, which reflects a critical status with other credits. This is concerning because most approved applicants have a history of existing paid credits, suggesting a more reliable repayment pattern. Additionally, your checking account status, which falls within the 0-200 DM range, is less favorable compared to the majority of approved applicants who typically have higher balances. This indicates potential financial instability.

To improve your chances for future applications, consider addressing these areas. Strengthening your credit history by ensuring timely payments on existing debts can enhance your profile. Additionally, working on increasing your savings and maintaining a healthier checking account balance will demonstrate better financial management. Lastly, exploring stable employment opportunities may also help in building a more favorable financial situation.
